reason: My bookkeeper already handles expenses in our app and it works well enough. I'm not handing a bot I've never heard of my Google account and the chat where my staff talk about money every day just to save a bit of typing.
objection: A random Telegram bot reading every message in my work group and getting into my Google Drive. Who's behind it, where does my data go, and what happens if it gets hacked?
would_change_my_mind: If my bookkeeper said it saves her real hours, it only read receipts and not the rest of the chat, and it could push straight into the app we already use instead of a separate Google Sheet.
